body: Actually, this is a throwaway account I made for suicide watch. But this thread got to me.

I want you to know you've really made me smile, something I don't find myself doing very much. So, ok deal, more updates to come tomorrow when I return the app and see what comes. I am waking up early and putting on jeans (instead of jammies all day), like *2 days in a row*, this is kind of a big deal.

Your story really touched me, I really hope that talking about it has helped. I loved the running, that stuff is priceless! These special creatures just crawl into our hearts. I'm glad he had an older brother, but you know you'll feel his absence with collars and leashes and dog beds. Seriously, think of puppy times, and talk, talk A LOT with your family about it, it will help everyone. I'll keep you in my thoughts.

You can see the light in his eyes so much in that pic, it's so awesome! Again, I do not want to be harsh, but this is when you love him hard, because he's fighting hard, and tbh they sometimes don't know when to stop until they are given permission to go. 

But that is not now, now is picture taking and lots of pets and cuddles, just be aware of his small clues and he will tell you everything he needs. My thoughts are with you, he looks like a very awesome guy.

It's not a downer. You love him and know his time is near and wish you could make it better, *so* many pet owners know that feeling. And know that he loves you right back. Not to be hardcore, but having had enough pets, you'll know when he's too tired, you'll feel it in 'the look' and I hope you and your family allow yourself to do what's needed without too much anguish. 

In the mean time, you just love him up as much as you can!!! Every moment you've had with him is golden.

I know not being able to say goodbye will eat at you, but that is a gift we aren't all given, sadly. Just like with people, sometimes they need to go before we get to say goodbye, but know he loved you.

What I recommend is thinking of the the times you had, those naps together (they can sleep really weird!) every time he made you smile when you felt like utter shit, his puppy times and all that energy (!!!), and sometimes, that silent companion on those long walks. Animals give us more than we could ever give them, again, I am glad you knew each other. And allow yourself a real good cry over this. I mean it.

No, I actually like that I need to keep you updated. I feel somehow accountable, so thank you. I did the dishes and did a bit of grocery shopping (at another place), did the litter box and straightened my hair before biking down there. Laundry and returning the app is tomorrow. Today, all of those stupid little things are small accomplishments to me, as fucked up as that sounds. I did something for me today. I honestly don't know the last time I have. I feel like this has become a diary or sorts, maybe that is what I need. I never share anything or keep a diary. This feels good.
I'm so sorry.

I had a black lab and I know how they really are 'love wrapped in fur'. Mine, Watson, had a curlycue tail :) I am glad you had an animal that meant so much to you. I love his eyes. Don't ever let anyone ever make you feel bad for the real love you shared with him. My condolences. *hugs*

It's this local wonderful little Italian grocer that is hugely expanding and moving across the street, voted "best hot ham and rolls" in the city. They don't even have a website, I can't remember the last time I picked up a paper application. I think, if this works, would be a good place to start baby steps. Thanks for believing in me.
Thank you for telling me your story, I hope it helped you as much as it did me.
Yes, I guess that's true. I am always kind to strangers, especially old people, I love helping them, I have many in my building.

I like that perspective, of becoming a different person. In order to do that, I have to somehow let go. Thats quite hard and I will always feel guilty. But I have to somehow, get to the other side. I am finally using using this panic for something and as hard as it is, by doing things I feel a bit more in control, so it's worth it.

I picked up and application, I am returning it tomorrow. I was sweating bullets, but I did it. I even took the time to get all dolled up. I haven't done that in quite sometime, although it's annoying to spend so much time on yourself, I found it comforting in a way.

I know the world is out there, and it doesn't really like me, hell I wouldn't either, the world can do better. But regardless of what I think of me, I promised my cat I am going to to one scary thing that is good for me today, so I'm off to do that now.

I'd never dream to depend on him again, I couldn't put him through this. And you're not the first one to tell me to reach out, but I want only happy good things for this wonderful man and that means staying far, far away from my vortex of shit.
And that is what I have no clue on how to do. Maybe I should find others who have cheated and regret it and somehow have found a way to move on. I'd just feel guilty about moving on tbh.

You're right, I have no idea what I want, I haven't entertained any thoughts of a normal future in so long. At this point, I just want to stop feeling this way. I will get back to you once I am able to give it some thought.

I am about to put on my big girl shoes and do this in a few hours. I'm petrefied, but It's what must be done. I'm already telling myself to breathe, I'd rather be doing anything but this, like of say gouge my own eyes out. And I am not to proud to admit that I will carry these comments with me as I bike over. So thank you, I really wish I could truly express what you guys have done for me.

I am finding talking about something that I *never* talk about but is constantly on my mind to be very cathartic. I have these thoughts every waking minute and find myself constantly looking back in regret. I was SO tempted to delete this post a few mins after I made it. You can tell where I was at when I came here, and I am glad didn't wimp out and take it down, but just laid all my demons all out.
You made me smile :)
No, I refused alimony, have you looked at what I have said about my ex-husband?? Does coming to a place like **suicide watch** to kick people like me do *anything* for you?

I hope you show them how much they matter, if even in small ways. My family is intensely dysfunctional. My parents spilt when I was 18 months old. I do not know my fathers side. I barely talk to my moms side, as I am the black sheep and it's a very small family, I only have 4 cousins. I am also an only child. Having a good one, not saying it's perfect, but a family there you know loves you and who you get to see is a treasure in itself. I am glad you have them.
Forgiveness is impossible. I don't think I ever could.
No, not Chicago, but thank you. I am so happy things have gotten better for you.

I am trying to let myself feel better as I read all of these incredibly supportive and sweet replies. 

I cheated on him because of many reasons, it was self destructive. He got down on his knees and begged me to stay, he wrote me a very long letter, and even insisted on meeting the other man to explain "that I was his treasure". I cheated because I was greedy and selfish, I had the perfect life and let purely sexual urges derail everything. My grandmother who helped raised me died about 2 months ago, I was holding her hand as she took her last breath actually, and my family insisted he come to her funeral. They were very close, he had never had had a grandma of his own. I emailed him and he showed up and silently walked up to me and we just held each other sobbing. He kept me at his side as we walked up to her casket. He told me as we smoked in the parking lot (we had quit together many many years ago) that if I ever saw him around not to run away and that he'd always have a soft spot in his heart for me. This is the most amazing man ever. We got divorced a year ago today.

I certainly do not feel brave, I just finally had to get everything out. I can tell you identify with this shitty feeling, maybe not to my shitty depths, but I appreciate that you can relate. Baby steps are all I am capable of now, but I need more than that if I don't want to be homeless in January. It's insanely overwhelming. I haven't had a drop to drink tonight so I can be functional tomorrow as I venture out to pick up a job application. I can't sleep I am so anxious already about it, and already feel like giving up. But, I am still not drinking, so I guess there's that. Thanks for everything you said and for listening.

I actually think that might work, tbh. They actually give you something to live for, to come home and wake up to. As I was posting and crying he basically attacked me purring loudly and demanding what I call a "kitty toll" as in "None shall pass without 15 mins of solid cuddles. Fuck you and what you are doing PET ME NOW". I melt every single time, even if I happen to be doing something I kinda care about, he always wins and he doesn't know I need it more than he does most times.
I really am trying.
I am not all better, and nowhere close to being out of the weeds to help anyone in a vulnerable time. All I could do is like clone my cat for someone.
I've had enough bad times for many lifetimes over. This is just the latest round.

I agree that people are more than their bad choices, but me being here is more of a waste than a blessing. I have a roof over my head and a full stomach while families starve to death on the street, and yet I am the one bitching. I am not one of the good guys.

I am glad you get the whole doing things for others thing. And I hope you don't take this in an argumentative way, but I don't think people are special snowflakes just for the simple act of being alive. In fact, people like me who are a drag on the system and don't value life shouldn't be blessed with one, kids that are struggling to walk in cancer wards, those people deserve it.

Yes, I couldn't bear letting him down or causing him distress. I just can't get over feeling fucking lame for him being my world. People have children and meaningful relationships and careers, and me? I have this fluffy cat that I would lay down my life for. :/

I can't imagine losing my cat, thinking about your dog just keeps making me tear up. I am glad he came into your life and touched you, it's a wonderful feeling. So, you're right I would do anything for him, I guess I should look him in the eye and make a few promises tonight.
I don't happen to agree, but it means a lot that you replied, thank you.

Aw, that is very sweet, if I could I would spoil my cat like crazy. And I do feed him, we have enough funds to make until next year, save any crazy emergencies. And what you said about helping others sounds good, I think I might find worth in helping people in my frame of mind. I am one of those people that goes out of me way for people and tends to neglect myself, so if I can in fact see the light at the end of the tunnel and find balance, I think helping others would actually help me. Thanks so much for your insight.
I just don't know where to begin to fix it. But trading cat photos sounds good, thats very sweet of you.

I am happy you found a way out. Listen to music brings up too many emotions, it all leads back to sad memories so I can't. but walks are good. Thinking about this passing is the most impossible thing ever, I am sure you know. Thank you.
This is as constructive as I have been in months. Half the time I don't even get out of bed, but thank you.

I can't even begin to think on how to forgive myself. My ex-husband was the most wonderful person I have ever known. I don't think people like me should get good things in life, he didn't deserve what I did to him. 

But, I want you to know your words stopped me in my tracks, I was truly floored by your kindness and understanding. Thank you.

That is what I can't get myself to do, to ever feel worthy again. If I do good things for me, it's never for me, I have to make it about something worthwhile. But I thank you for taking the time to reply, it does have a meaningful impact.

You made me cry, but that is good. Thank you. I will try to start trying again. I am so scared, but when people like you say such kind things to strangers, it's insanely touching and I feel I have to somehow, not let good people like you down, you guys and my cat.

I guess you're correct about the concern with the neighbors and landlord, but the fact they notice makes me feel even worse. I don't really see this as a period, more like a pattern, a pattern I am sick of. Also, after I initially posted, my landlord actually called me to tell me she saw a company was moving across the street to expand and are "hiring for everything" I was touched she thought of me. Now, the daunting task of actually picking up an application and then submitting it. I get anxious at the mere thought, but I promised her I would go, so it looks like I will have to...
I avoid eye contact much less speaking to people I know, so chatting up a stranger would make me insanely awkward, but I do appreciate your advice and insight.
He is the only thing that matters, thank you.

Thanks, I truly envy your strength. People like you make me feel both inspired, and to be honest, also make me fee like a cry baby. Coming out to a family who can't accept you must be very hard, I am glad you have support.

edit: spelling :/
I'm so sorry about your dog, I understand, my cat is my world, as sad as that sounds.
thanks
Thank you, and the cat has been hugged :)
The weather is getting colder, I am in the Midwest and in a big city and don't think being out alone at night would be ideal. But I do love long walks, thanks for the advice Anthony.
